answers.rationale: The effective_rate relation establishes job J1 at $240/hr using the named rate_card TOW rate (service_conditions §1).
The job_charge relation establishes $2,280 for J2: 8h at $240/hr plus 1h overtime at 1.5× (V-BAY day total 9h > 8; service_conditions §2).
tow_job records show vessel V-BAY on job J2 at berth B4 and job J5 at berth B12.
The billable_hours relation has no established quantity for J5, J6, or J7; only J1–J4 have billable_hours tuples.

J7 billing_outcome is insufficient_evidence with reason 'B12 after-hours towing without emergency documentation'; purpose_requirement_failure berth_b12_after_hours records no emergency log attached for J7.
Berth B4 jobs are J1, J2, and J6; only J1 ($960) and J2 ($2,280) have established job_charge entries, totaling $3,240.
